verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Nix's package management, environments, flakes commands (nix build, nix run, nix flake new) but never mentions the flake.lock lockfile format, its structure, or its diffability/readability for tooling or agents. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of flake.lock's JSON/text format, guidance on reading/diffing it, or agent-oriented tooling around it.
